name: AGE 05 - Operations Ledger Dashboard - Read Only

parameters.query:
WITH c AS (SELECT status, count(*)::integer AS count FROM age_dispatcher.cycle GROUP BY status),
 b AS (SELECT state, count(*)::integer AS count FROM age_dispatcher.batch GROUP BY state),
 r AS (SELECT status, count(*)::integer AS count FROM age_dispatcher.reservation GROUP BY status)
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM c) AS cycles,
 (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM b) AS batches,
 (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM r) AS recipients,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM age_dispatcher.portfolio) AS portfolios,
 (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM age_dispatcher.preflight_view WHERE reason='READY_FOR_OTHER_PRECHECKS') AS ready_for_other_checks;
